headline: Modal raised $750 million in a Series D round at a $15.75 billion valuation
body: Modal was valued at $15.75 billion in a Series D funding round led by Accel. CEO Erik Bernhardsson says usage has tripled since the company's May Series C, when it was valued at $4.65 billion.

evidence.text: Modal was valued at $15.75 billion in a Series D funding round in which it raised $750 million, CEO Erik Bernhardsson said
Modal’s latest funding round was led by Accel, per the post.
Modal’s new valuation is more than triple the $4.65 billion valuation the company achieved in a May Series C round in which is raised $355 million.
Since then, usage has tripled and we’ve grown more than 15x year-over-year.
